data.observations: The 44-test upstream suite passed. Three compact Lab invalid cases and the separately retained congruence candidate changed from rejection to acceptance under the isolated declaration-type fault.
data.limitations: E0 on one pinned Nanoda revision and three seeded omissions. The compact selection excludes one file over 65,536 bytes; the two augmented inputs are separately labeled. This does not measure fault prevalence, production defects, whole-corpus adequacy or general checker correctness.
data.decision: Retain the three compact detecting cases as evidence that the Lab corpus protects this broad declaration check. No new PR or confirmation is selected from this known-case E0 result.
data.cost: 188 logical runs: two isolated builds, two unchanged upstream suites and 184 checker cells. Shared execution across the campaign produced 376 valid repaired attempts; earlier invalid attempts are retained separately. Token/model cost unavailable.
